subtitle: Lightweight Modern Server Panel
rt_store_desc: Select only the web servers, databases, and language runtimes you need and install them in one click.
port_help_proxy: 💡 What is App Port? Unlike PHP, Rust/Python/Node.js/Java apps listen on an internal port number, and Nginx connects your domain to it. Enter your app's listening port (e.g., Node.js 3000, Django 8000, Rust/Spring Boot 8080).
tip_ssl: Automatically issue free Let's Encrypt HTTPS SSL certificate
tip_ftp: Automatically create dedicated FTP/SFTP account for file uploads
tip_db: Automatically create MariaDB/MySQL database and user
site_uncheck_warn: ⚠️ Unchecked options (FTP/SFTP, DB) will NOT be created. To install boards/CMS (CBoard, Gnuboard, WordPress, etc.), make sure to check 'Auto Create DB'! (Leaving ID/PW blank auto-generates 'domain_ftp' / 'domain_db' with random passwords.)
site_wizard_hint: 💡 Both custom domains (aaa.com) and subdomains (sub.chost.work) can be provisioned with Language, Framework, SSL, FTP/SFTP, and DB at once.
app_port_guide: 💡 What is App Port? It is the internal port your app listens on. Use the same port number you entered when creating the site.
setup_modal_desc: Before creating domains, choose the web server, database, and language runtimes to install in one click. (You can install more later in Runtime Store.)
ph_db_sql: SQL Query (e.g. SELECT * FROM sites LIMIT 20;)
guide_db_studio:
💡 Quick Guide: Inspect and back up databases safely without phpMyAdmin.
• MariaDB: Select a site database to view tables, run SQL, or download a .sql dump.
• SQLite: Enter a .db path on the server (e.g. /var/lib/chost/chost.db).
guide_storage:
💡 Quick Guide: Keep disk usage clean without risking important data.
1) Click [Preview Scan] first to inspect old log files.
2) Click [Safe Clean] to compress old .log files and remove .gz/.tmp. (Databases and uploads are strictly protected)
guide_file_editor: 💡 Quick Guide: Click any folder or file in the browser below to open and edit it without typing long paths.
guide_web_term: 💡 Quick Guide: Run single server check commands directly from your browser or use the quick buttons below.
guide_sec_pw: 💡 Note: Change your CHost panel login password here.
guide_sec_reset: 💡 Note: Reset the panel for clean testing. Soft Reset only resets panel lists and setup wizard; Full Reset removes all created sites, FTP, DBs, and web files.
opt_reset_soft: Soft Reset (Reset panel lists & setup wizard only)
opt_reset_full: Full Reset (Permanently delete all sites, FTP, DBs & web folders)
ph_git_url: Auto-install from Git URL (optional) e.g. https://github.com/user/repo.git
sc_git_help: 💡 Sites installed from a Git URL can be updated to the latest source here. The app is rebuilt and restarted automatically, and visitors see a 'starting' page meanwhile.
sc_git_none: This site was not installed from Git. (Enter a Git URL when creating a new site to use this.)
guide_sc_domains: 💡 Enter additional domains (e.g. www.example.com) to attach besides the main domain, one per line, then save.
guide_sc_conf: 💡 Edit the web server config (server / VirtualHost) directly. Changes are applied only after the syntax check passes, so a typo will not take your server down.
sc_php_help: 💡 Switch the PHP version of this site instantly. (7.4 for legacy Gnuboard, 8.3 recommended for new sites)
sc_ssl_help: 💡 Check the status of the free Let's Encrypt HTTPS certificate and issue or renew it.
guide_sd_help: 💡 By default only the web server config is removed. Select below only the extra items to delete together.
sd_chk_ftp: Also delete the FTP / SFTP account
sd_chk_db: Also delete the database (MariaDB) and DB account
sd_chk_files: Permanently delete the web root folder (/www/wwwroot/...) files too
msg_db_deleted: ✅ The DB and DB account were deleted.
msg_ftp_deleted: ✅ The FTP account was safely deleted. (Site files kept)
pw_min4: Enter a new password of at least 4 characters.
pw_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
pw_changed_alert: The admin password has been changed.
pw_changed_ok: ✅ The admin password was changed successfully!
reset_done_full: ✅ Full reset complete! Restarting the initial setup wizard.
rt_select_one: Select at least one package to install.
rt_all_done: All selected package installations have finished.
ver_tip: Current v{cur} → latest v{latest} one-click update
ver_uptodate_alert: ✅ You are on the latest version (v{cur})!
ver_confirm:
A new version (v{latest}) is available!
Update automatically now and restart CHost?
ph_maria_sql: SHOW TABLES; or SELECT * FROM table_name LIMIT 20;
login_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {min} min.
guide_alert: 💡 Get notified via webhook (Slack, Discord, etc.) or Telegram when disk exceeds 90%, a site goes down, or an SSL certificate expires within 14 days. A recovery notice is sent too.
alert_test_fail: ❌ Sending failed (make sure you saved first):
guide_fw: 💡 One click opens only SSH, web (80/443) and the panel port and blocks the rest. The ports you need are allowed before enabling, so you won't lock yourself out.
fw_confirm: SSH, web (80/443) and the panel port will be allowed and all other ports blocked. Continue?
guide_php_ini: 💡 Edit the core options of the selected PHP version. (Applies to every site using that version, e.g. upload size)
login_otp_needed: 📱 Enter the 6-digit code from your OTP app.
guide_tfa: 💡 Confirm each login once more with an OTP app such as Google Authenticator or Authy. If you lose your phone, disable it on the server with sudo /opt/chost/chost --reset-2fa.
tfa_scan: 📷 Scan the QR code with your OTP app, enter the 6-digit code it shows, then press [Enable].
tfa_enabled_ok: ✅ Two-factor authentication is on. An OTP code is required from the next login.
guide_ipw: 💡 Only the IPs listed here (or ranges like 1.2.3.0/24) can open the panel. Leave empty for no restriction. If you get locked out, run sudo /opt/chost/chost --clear-ip-whitelist on the server.
ipw_saved: ✅ Saved. Only the listed IPs can open the panel now.
guide_entry: 💡 Once set, the login page opens only at your secret address instead of http://server-ip:port/. Forgot it? Run sudo /opt/chost/chost --show-entry on the server (remove: --reset-entry).
entry_confirm: After saving, the login page opens only at the address below. Be sure to write it down!
entry_saved: ✅ Saved. Moving to the new address...
entry_cleared: ✅ Secure path removed. Moving to the default address (/)...
guide_dbacc: 💡 Create a new database with its own account in one step, or change an existing account password. (Password 8+ chars, no quotes, backslash or spaces)
dbacc_pw_ok: ✅ Password changed. (Remember to update the DB password in your site config too)
pg_not_installed: PostgreSQL is not installed. Install it from the 'Runtime Store'.
guide_bk: 💡 Every day at the chosen hour, all databases (MariaDB, PostgreSQL), site files and CHost settings are compressed into /www/backup. (node_modules, build folders and .git are skipped) Older backups beyond the keep count are removed automatically.
bk_started: ⏳ Backup started. It will appear in the list below when finished.
